claims.statement: For even n, q_n(x)=(-1)^{sum_{r<s}x_rx_s} is tensor-prime, has U=I=n/2 and G=3n/2-n2^{1-n}, while every coordinate has Delta_iG/Inf_i=4n-1-(2n-1)2^{2-n}. Hence GC14 and every fixed all-tensor-prime good-coordinate pair are false.
claims.scope: All even dimensions; genuine uniform-cube Boolean complete-graph quadratic phases.
claims.not_claimed: This is not a GU or FEI counterexample; the family satisfies G<3I.

claims.statement: Universal GU for a fixed pair follows if the good-coordinate inequality is proved only for tensor-prime Boolean functions with positive GU residual; the stronger all-tensor-prime quantifier is unnecessary.
claims.scope: Minimal-counterexample induction for any fixed finite a and 0<=b<1.
claims.first_unpaid_line: Prove the residual-qualified coordinate inequality with one absolute pair, retaining child residual and signed KL terms.
